sections.theory:
Matters of knowledge and action

The crime of zina is intolerable in an Islamic society; in the same way, making a false accusation of zina is also a most serious crime, and its punishment too is very great.

Before entering anyone's house, one should seek permission from the people of the house and greet the people of the house with salam. Further, it should be remembered that the four walls of a home are the protection of human dignity.

Allah Almighty has commanded the believing men and believing women to guard their gaze and their private parts. In the same way it is not appropriate for a believing woman to display her adornment, beauty and finery before non-mahram men. We should remember that it is easy and effective to stop any evil and corruption at its first stage.
